summary: Reproduced that NixlFileManager.clear() deleted another model's cache file and an unrelated file on a shared base directory. Scoped HiCacheNixl clears to config_suffix, added boundary-aware filename filtering, and made missing or degenerate scopes refuse deletion. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32705 was inspected before implementation; it remains open and is not present in the prepared base.

tests.what_was_measured: On the unmodified implementation, verified that clear() removed the calling model's file, a second model's file, and unrelated.txt. Raw output: reports/j-06bfbe25a9c6/raw/failing-before-reproduction.log
The preserved regression failed before the implementation accepted a scoped suffix. Raw output: reports/j-06bfbe25a9c6/raw/failing-before-unit.log

Three CPU tests passed: owned files are deleted while other-model, overlapping-suffix, and unrelated files survive; unusable scopes preserve data; a concurrently missing base directory is tolerated. Raw output: reports/j-06bfbe25a9c6/raw/passing-after-unit-final.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, CI registration, and policy hooks passed. Raw output: reports/j-06bfbe25a9c6/raw/pre-commit.log

remaining_limitations: No full HTTP server or real NIXL POSIX/GDS deployment was started; validation directly exercised the checked-out NixlFileManager implementation and its production bucket routing on temporary shared directories.

No multi-rank deletion race was reproduced. The correction prevents ranks from deleting other suffixes but same-instance ranks may still attempt the same scoped names depending on their configured suffix.
No GPU execution was performed because this admin clear path is CPU-only; this does not validate model inference, GPU transfer, or distributed serving behavior.
